conclusions: Instruction volume is the primary observed gap: about159-167M retired instructions per Fast request versus2.5-2.6M Node across100 requests; higher Scriptw aggregate IPC and lower branch-miss rate do not support branch prediction as the main explanation.

Repeated variable-name resolution is a measured hotspot: about92percent of sampled StringEquality leaf weight has EnvironmentIdentifierResolve as the immediate physical caller; most of that work originates in React vn.

Fast code generation creates excessive spill frames and page probes. These are real costs but the two exact probe loops are only about0.22percent of retired instructions and5-6percent of sampled locations, so they cannot explain the entire surplus.
Speed/Backtracking shrinks native frames/code substantially while removing only about5.3percent of retired instructions; backend policy alone leaves the main semantic-work problem.

All22 dominant vn sites resolve global or optional-global constructor names but begin at the current lexical environment. Next work should prove global-start resolution and reuse the existing live global lookup path rather than scanning irrelevant scopes. Total heap and arguments-object allocation counts remain unmeasured.
